purpose: Describe provenance and completeness metadata for a passive demonstration package.

package_layout.raw_events: optional raw input evidence retained separately from normalized steps

demo_id.description: Stable identifier for this recording package.

demo_name.description: Human-supplied label; it is not a strategy or executable objective.

ended_at.description: Set only when the recorder exits or fails.

recorder_version.description: Recorder implementation identifier used for reproducibility.

application_identity.description: Evidence of the observed application/window; not a command target.

game_window.description: Observed window geometry and coordinate-space provenance.

evidence_refs.description: Relative references inside the package or repository evidence tree.

error.description: Required for FAILED sessions; must not be hidden by a partial episode.

human_annotations.description: Explicit human notes kept separate from recorder facts and never auto-promoted.

completeness_rules: RECORDING is not a compilable demonstration.
FAILED or missing-footer packages are incomplete and must be refused by compilers by default.
COMPLETED proves capture integrity only; it does not prove strategy correctness or production readiness.
Metadata may identify evidence provenance but may not assert an unobserved objective, policy, or success condition.

knowledge_status.direct_capture: FACT only when the corresponding event/observation reference exists.
knowledge_status.action_mapping: INFERENCE unless a configured control match is uniquely evidenced.
knowledge_status.missing_or_conflicting: UNKNOWN; preserve the gap rather than filling it.
